description:
At Lovy, we're building a world-class creative team, and we're looking for a hungry Junior Direct Response Copywriter who wants to become one of the best.



This isn't a content writing job.



You'll spend your days researching markets, studying winning ads, developing creative angles, and writing long-for
ta ad scripts that sell.



If names like Eugene Schwartz, Gary Halbert, David Ogilvy, John Carlton, or Clayton Makepeace are already part of your vocabulary, keep reading.



What You'll Do

Research winning ads using Meta Ad Library, GetHookd, Atria, and other research tools.

Develop high-converting long-for
ta ad scripts for cold traffic.

Research customer psychology, market awareness, and messaging angles.

Analyze creative performance and contribute ideas for testing.

Work closely with our creative team to bring scripts to life.

Continuously study and improve your copywriting craft.



We're Looking For Someone Who



Has strong knowledge of long-form direct response copywriting.

Speaks and writes fluent English.

Is available to work full-time.

Has experience writing for health or wellness DTC brands.

Has written Meta ad scripts for campaigns that have spent at least $30,000.

Has experience marketing to Tier 1 countries (US, UK, AU, or CA).

Loves studying copywriting through books, paid courses, masterminds, or mentorships.

Has developed their own AI workflows or prompting systems.

Can receive direct feedback and iterate quickly.

Understands Meta advertising compliance, especially in the health niche.



Compensation & Benefits



$12,000 USD/year base salary

Performance bonus (On-Target Earnings: $25,000–$35,000/year)

14 days Paid Time Off

Friendly, non-corporate culture

Minimal meetings (less than 4 hours per week)

Long-term career growth opportunities



How to Apply



Complete the application form and answer every question thoughtfully.

title: Experienced Brand Manager Assistant to support 12+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
description:
Role Overview



We're hiring a Brand Manager Assistant who will work directly under the Senior Brand Manager to execute day-to-day brand operations. This is a hands-on role focused on the “legwork” that drives performance: optimizing listings, managing keyword research, coordinating creative projects, and pulling actionable data.



If the Senior Brand Manager sets the playbook, the Associate Brand Manager runs the plays — ensuring everything gets executed on time, correctly, and at a high level.



Key Responsibilities

1. Listing Management & Optimization

Create, update, and fully optimize Amazon product listings (titles, bullets, descriptions, images, videos, A+ content).

Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to improve rankings and visibility.

Ensure all listings remain Rufus and Cosmos compliant with Amazon’s latest requirements.

Test content variations (A/B testing) to improve CTR and conversions.



2. Data Research & Analysis

Pull performance data from Amazon Seller Central and external tools (Data Dive, Helium 10, Jungle Scout).

Identify trends, keyword shifts, and competitor activity.

Provide actionable recommendations to the Senior Brand Manager to improve conversions, CTR, and sales velocity.



3. Cross-Team Collaboration

Work closely with the graphic design team to request, coordinate, and deliver images, infographics, and A+ creatives.

Partner with the marketing team to support product launches, promotions, and review-generation initiatives.

Ensure all projects are aligned with deadlines, strategy, and brand guidelines.



4. Conversion-Focused Execution

Continuously update and refine listings to improve conversion rates and customer engagement.

Maintain Amazon Brand Stores, A+ content, and ad creatives for consistency and performance.

Assist in preparing assets for influencer campaigns and external marketing pushes.



5. Project & Compliance Support

Own the administrative “heavy lifting” of flat files, bulk uploads, and catalog troubleshooting.

Flag compliance issues, unauthorized sellers, or listing errors for quick resolution.

Support market expansion efforts by preparing research and draft listings for new product opportunities.



Skills & Qualifications



2+ years experience in Amazon FBA operations, brand management, or digital marketing.

Proficient in Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing creation, and troubleshooting.

Strong skills in SEO, keyword research, and listing optimization.

Data-driven mindset; confident in Google Sheets and reporting.

Strong communication skills to work cross-functionally with design, marketing, and operations teams.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple deadlines.



What Success Looks Like

Every listing across assigned brands is fully optimized, compliant, and performing.

Senior Brand Manager receives clear, accurate reports and recommendations.

Creative assets are delivered on time because you coordinated smoothly with design.



Product launches happen seamlessly with marketing and review strategies in place.

Conversions and rankings consistently improve due to your execution. If you feel you are the right fit, please respond to the job with the title " The Best Supporting Branding Manager Out There!"

Kind Regards,

Tam Ma

title: Content Repurposing Video Editor for a Leading Education Creator (Long-Term Position)
description:
Hi! I'm Matt Miller, creator of Ditch That Textbook, one of the largest K–12 education brands in the world. Through keynote speaking, books, newsletters, online courses, and social media, I help hundreds of thousands of educators create better learning experiences for students.



Every year I speak at conferences around the world, publish multiple newsletters, create online courses, and produce hundreds of hours of educational content.



I'm looking for someone who can: 

>> Transform keynote speeches, workshops, webinars, and podcasts into engaging short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, and LinkedIn.

>> Edit my talking-head videos and screen recordings into polished, scroll-stopping content with captions, jump cuts, zooms, graphics, and other engaging visual elements.



This is a position that starts as part-time but can easily grow into a full-time position as you earn my trust and create quality content within the timeline provided.



I want to grow my social media following on multiple channels through regular, engaging video content. I'll need help creating and posting the video, but I also want someone with a good eye for what catches people's attention -- and an ability to identify the best parts of longer videos to clip out for social media videos.



This is not just a video editing job. You'll become an important part of our content team and help bring ideas to life for hundreds of thousands of educators.



I'm looking for someone who can learn my editing style (and even improve on it), suggest their own improvements, identify great content, and require few revisions.



I like videos that feel modern, fast-paced, and polished—but not over-edited. I appreciate dynamic captions, subtle motion graphics, strategic zooms, occasional sound effects, and edits that keep viewers engaged without becoming distracting.



I am not looking for someone to wait for editing instructions. I want someone who watches my content and says:



>> "This 45-second section would make a fantastic Reel."

>> "This hook isn't strong enough."

>> "I think this version would perform better."



Must Have:

>> Excellent English

>> Short-form editing

>> Dynamic captions

>> Fast communication

>> Strong internet



You should be highly skilled in at least one professional editing platform (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, etc.) and willing to adapt to my workflow if needed.



Preferred:

>> Canva

>> Motion graphics

>> Educational content

>> Creator economy experience



What you'll get:

>> Long-term work with an established creator

>> A collaborative relationship where your ideas matter

>> Opportunities to grow into additional responsibilities over time

>> Flexible work schedule

>> The chance to help shape content seen by hundreds of thousands of educators around the world



In your application: Include work samples, a portfolio, etc. ... testimonials from previous clients, etc.



Compensation: Competitive and based on experience, portfolio quality, and the results of a paid editing test.



Bonus: If you can create eye-catching visual posts for Insta,
,
, etc. in Canva, I'll probably have even more work for you. 



I'm not looking for someone who simply edits videos. I'm looking for someone who studies why people keep watching videos.



If you naturally notice pacing, hooks, storytelling, and audience retention—and you enjoy making videos more engaging—I would love to hear from you.



To show me you've read this entire post, begin your application with the words: Purple Pineapple. (Seriously. Just somewhere at the top of your application, write the words "Purple Pineapple" to show me your attention to detail.)

title: Cold Caller, Lead Generator, and Appointment Setter (Full Time, $7-$8/Hr)
description:
About Us



We are a growing B2B lead generation agency operating three fast growing brands. We connect UK business owners with funding, property, and invoice finance solutions, and we are looking for a sharp, confident voice to join our outbound team.



The Role



We need an expert cold caller, lead generator, and appointment setter who can pick up the phone, build instant rapport, and book qualified appointments for our sales team. Lead generation is a core skill for this role, not an add on. You should be comfortable sourcing and qualifying your own leads, not just working from a list handed to you. This is not an entry level role. We are looking for someone who already knows how to handle objections, keep a natural conversational tone on cold calls, and consistently hit booking targets.



You will be calling into the UK market across all three of our brands, so comfort with a UK accent and audience is a must.



What You Will Be Doing





Sourcing and building your own lead lists in addition to working provided lists

Making outbound cold calls to UK business owners and decision makers

Qualifying leads against our criteria before booking

Booking appointments directly into our sales team's calendar

Logging every call outcome accurately in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Following call scripts while still sounding natural and human, not robotic

Handling objections calmly and confidently

Hitting daily and weekly booking targets

Working full UK/BST hours consistently, with strong attendance and punctuality





What We Are Looking For





3+ years of proven cold calling, lead generation, and appointment setting experience, ideally into the UK market

Strong basic lead generation skills, you should know how to research and build a lead list, not just work from one

A track record you can point to (targets hit, appointments booked, campaigns you have run)

Excellent spoken English with clear, natural pronunciation

Confident, resilient, and unbothered by rejection

Comfortable with CRM tools (GoHighLevel experience is a big plus)

A quiet, professional home office setup with a stable internet connection and a good headset

Available to work full UK/BST hours, no exceptions





Pay and Trial Structure





3 week paid trial at $7 USD/hour

Once you pass the trial, your rate increases to $8 USD/hour

This is a long term role for the right person, not a short term gig







How to Apply



Read this whole listing carefully before you apply. We are filtering out people who do not read instructions, since attention to detail matters a lot in this role.



Step 1: Start your application message with the phrase "Lucky cold-caller" as the first two words. Applications that do not start with this exact phrase will not be reviewed.



Step 2: Answer this logic question in your application:





A sales rep makes 40 calls in a day. 25% of those calls connect with a real person. Of the calls that connect, 1 in 5 turns into a booked appointment. How many appointments were booked that day?







Step 3: Record a 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself. This video is required, applications without it will not be considered. In your video, please cover:





Your name and where you are calling in from

Your cold calling and appointment setting experience, with real numbers if you have them

A quick example of how you would handle a common objection like "I'm not interested" or "send me an
 instead"

Why you are a strong fit for a UK facing outbound role





Upload your video to Google Drive, or Loom, and share the link in your application.



We are excited to find someone who can hit the ground running. Looking forward to hearing from you.

description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Behavioral Health Medical Biller – Pediatric Counseling & Assessment Services



Location: Phillipines/Remote



Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours



Compensation: $7-$8 USD/ Hour



Type: Long-Term | Full-Time



Reports To: Revenue Cycle Manager / Billing Supervisor



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Offshore Behavioral Health Medical Biller to support revenue cycle operations for a behavioral health practice specializing in counseling, therapy, psychological assessments, and behavioral health services for children and adolescents. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience billing behavioral health claims, managing payer requirements, and working with CPT codes related to counseling, psychotherapy, diagnostic evaluations, and psychological testing.



This role is responsible for ensuring timely claim submission, payment posting, denial management, insurance follow-up, and maintaining compliance with payer and regulatory requirements to maximize reimbursement and reduce accounts receivable.



What You’ll Do





Claims Management



- Prepare, review, and submit accurate behavioral health claims to commercial payers, Medicaid, and managed care organizations

- Verify claim accuracy, including diagnosis codes (ICD-10), CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, provider information, and authorization requirements

- Submit electronic and corrected claims in accordance with payer guidelines

- Monitor claim status and ensure timely reimbursement



Behavioral Health Billing



- Bill and manage claims related to individual counseling and psychotherapy services, family therapy and caregiver counseling, group therapy services, diagnostic evaluations, psychological and neuropsychological assessments, behavioral health screenings, and telehealth behavioral health services

- Ensure proper utilization of behavioral health CPT codes and modifiers as required by payers



Denials and Accounts Receivable Follow-Up



- Research and resolve denied, rejected, and underpaid claims

- Perform insurance follow-up through payer portals and direct communication with insurance representatives

- Identify root causes of denials and implement corrective actions

- Appeal denied claims and track appeal outcomes



Patient and Insurance Eligibility



- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits

- Validate behavioral health coverage, copays, deductibles, and authorization requirements

- Confirm authorization approvals and visit limits for counseling and assessment services



Payment Posting and Reconciliation



- Post insurance and patient payments accurately

- Reconcile payments against submitted claims

- Identify and investigate payment discrepancies



Revenue Cycle Support



- Maintain aging reports and prioritize outstanding accounts receivable

- Meet productivity and collection goals

- Generate reports related to billing performance, denials, and reimbursement trends

title: Medical Insurance, Referral & Operations Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are a growing healthcare organization seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented professional to support insurance, referral, and operational workflows.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working in healthcare operations and takes pride in keeping processes moving efficiently. The successful candidate will help coordinate patient referrals, insurance-related processes, reporting, and administrative workflows while working closely with clinical and operational teams.



This is a full-time remote position with opportunities to take ownership of key functions and contribute to the continued growth of the organization.



POSITION OVERVIEW

This is not a basic administrative assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can independently manage patient referrals, insurance verification, authorization workflows, reporting responsibilities, and operational tasks with minimal supervision.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working within established processes while helping identify opportunities for improvement.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Patient Referral Intake & Coordination

- Receive and process incoming patient referrals

- Review referral documentation for completeness and accuracy

- Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and supporting documentation

- Communicate with referral sources regarding missing information

- Coordinate referral review with clinical providers

- Track referrals from intake through scheduling and onboarding

- Maintain accurate referral records and documentation



2. Insurance Verification & Authorization

- Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits

- Review payer requirements and coverage guidelines

- Submit and track prior authorizations

- Follow up with insurance carriers regarding pending requests

- Document insurance findings accurately

- Assist with resolving insurance-related issues that may impact patient care



3. Claims & Revenue Cycle Support

- Monitor claim status and payer responses

- Assist with claims follow-up activities

- Research and document denied or delayed claims

- Support revenue cycle workflows and administrative processes

- Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation



4. Operations & Administrative Support

- Prepare recurring operational reports

- Maintain patient, referral, and operational tracking systems

- Monitor work queues and follow-up items

- Ensure documentation is complete and organized

- Follow established SOPs and workflows

- Assist with scheduling-related administrative tasks when needed

- Support special projects and operational initiatives



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within the first 30 days, you should be able to:

Process referrals accurately and independently

Verify insurance coverage with minimal supervision

Manage recurring responsibilities without reminders

Follow established procedures consistently

Communicate professionally with referral partners, patients, and insurance representatives

Escalate only exceptions requiring leadership review

Contribute to a smooth and reliable patient onboarding experience



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum 2 years of experience in healthcare administration, medical billing, insurance verification, referral coordination, patient intake, or a related healthcare role

- Experience working with medical insurance plans

- Strong organizational and time management skills

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to work independently and prioritize competing responsibilities

- Proficiency with spreadsheets, web-based software, and healthcare systems

- Ability to work and remain available during standard business hours of 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST/EDT).

- Reliable internet connection and dedicated remote work environment



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Prior authorization experience

Medicare and Medicaid experience

Medical billing and claims experience

Referral intake, patient coordination, or care coordination experience

Experience with EMR/EHR systems

Experience supporting physicians, nurse practitioners, or other clinical teams

Experience communicating with insurance carriers and healthcare providers

Experience in a medical practice, outpatient clinic, healthcare organization, or related healthcare setting

Experience managing multiple workflows simultaneously while maintaining accuracy



WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

Takes ownership of responsibilities

Follows through on commitments

Works proactively rather than reactively

Pays close attention to detail

Uses available resources before escalating questions

Communicates professionally and respectfully

Enjoys creating structure and keeping processes organized

Can be trusted to manage recurring responsibilities independently





APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please complete the application form below:







IMPORTANT: To ensure a fair and consistent review process, only candidates who complete the application form will be considered. Applications submitted without a completed form may not be reviewed.



Qualified candidates may be invited to complete an assessment and interview process.

title: Resource Specialist
description:
Role Summary

The Resource Specialist serves as the primary bridge between a client’s clinical rehabilitation plan and the practical, real-world resources they need to succeed. Reporting directly to the Rehabilitation Coordinator, this role focuses on high-touch client interaction to identify social, financial, and logistical gaps and proactively sourcing solutions to fill them.



Core Responsibilities

- Direct Client Needs Assessment: Lead intensive one-on-one consultations with clients to identify specific barriers to recovery (e.g., housing instability, lack of transportation, food insecurity, or financial strain).

- Resource Mapping & Vetting: Build and maintain a comprehensive directory of community partners, NGOs, government programs, and private charities that can provide immediate assistance.

- Case Support for the RC: Act as the "boots on the ground" for the Rehab Coordinator by managing the non-clinical logistics of a client’s recovery plan.

- Application Assistance: Guide clients through the technical process of applying for social security, disability benefits, healthcare subsidies, or vocational training grants.

- Advocacy & Liaison: Contact external agencies on behalf of the client to expedite services and ensure they are receiving the full scope of available support.

- Goal Tracking: Regularly interview clients to monitor the effectiveness of provided resources and pivot strategies if a particular resource is no longer a fit.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Communication: Exceptional active listening and interviewing skills; ability to explain complex social service systems to clients clearly.

- Empathy & Professionalism: Ability to build rapport with diverse populations while maintaining clear professional boundaries.

- Organization: Strong multitasking skills to manage a high volume of client requests and resource tracking.

- Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to finding creative solutions for clients with limited access to traditional support systems.

title: E-Commerce VA & Bookkeeper Reformly
description:
About Reformly

Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community.



Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are a young, ambitious team, and we are looking for an A-player to help us scale our operations and optimize our profitability.





The Role: Mission

To take full ownership of Reformly’s financial administration and daily logistics, bringing impeccable accuracy, proactive communication, and structured execution to our processes in order to drive operational efficiency and profitability.





Tasks & Responsibilities

As our Finance & Operations Assistant, you will sit at the intersection of numbers and logistics. Your day-to-day will involve:

- Daily P&L Management: Keeping the daily Profit & Loss statements 100% up-to-date and accurate, with zero backlog.



- Invoice & Cost Auditing: Rigorously checking invoices and cost breakdowns to identify and resolve any discrepancies or errors.



- Data Entry & Calculations: Flawlessly inputting financial data and running ad-hoc cost calculations as needed.



- Order Fulfillment: Seamlessly managing daily order processing.



- Inventory Management: Maintaining an accurate, real-time inventory tracking sheet.



- Structured Reporting: Translating raw data into highly readable, organized updates for management.



- Proactive Issue Flagging: Immediately raising a red flag when processes slow down, numbers are off, or margins are at risk, and proactively bringing solutions.





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by results, not just hours worked. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive Profitability: Actively audit cost breakdowns, check invoices for discrepancies, and identify operational efficiencies to help realize a gross margin increase from 70% to 73%.



2. Financial Precision: Maintain a 100?curate, up-to-date Daily P&L and cost calculation spreadsheet, ensuring all data entry is processed flawlessly with zero backlog at the end of each week.



3. Fulfillment & Inventory Mastery: Achieve and maintain an average order-to-delivery time of 12 days or less by taking full ownership of daily fulfillment operations. Guarantee zero stockouts through meticulous inventory tracking.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Ownership & Autonomy: You do not need hand-holding or micro-management. You deeply understand the end goal and independently navigate the path to get there. You take full responsibility for outcomes, both successes and failures.



- High Standards & Attention to Detail: You are a healthy perfectionist. You inherently double-check work before submitting. You do not let small details, incorrect numbers, or minor logistical errors slip through the cracks.



- Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets. You can quickly process financial and operational data, spot trends, calculate costs accurately, and draw logical conclusions without getting overwhelmed.



- Organization & Structured Planning: You plan, organize, and schedule tasks in a highly efficient and productive manner. You bring order to chaos and naturally create systems to keep daily operations running smoothly.



- Proactivity & Problem Solving: You act without being told what to do. You can think critically outside the standard operating procedures (SOPs) when exceptions occur. You bring solutions to the table, not just problems.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not align with these:

- All-In Mentality (Impact Over Hours): We are not here just to collect a paycheck; we are here to achieve ambitious goals. You genuinely believe in what we are building and take deep pride in the results you deliver.



- Extreme Ownership (Radically Reliable): You understand that you are a crucial pillar of the team. When you take on a responsibility, the team can trust blindly that it will be executed flawlessly.



- Radical Candor (Direct & Transparent): No beating around the bush. We value efficient, clear, and straightforward communication. You are open, honest, and not afraid to give or receive direct feedback.



- High Velocity (Move Fast & Adapt): We are a young, fast-moving team. You thrive in a high-paced environment, pivot quickly when needed, and combine a sense of urgency with high execution power.



- Humble & Hungry (Continuous Growth): You bring positive energy. You are highly ambitious but leave your ego at the door. You are fiercely eager to learn, extremely coachable, and constantly looking to level up.





How to Apply

We do not want standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself.

title: Finance & Operations Assistant Reformly (E-Commerce & Mobile App)
description:
About Reformly

Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community.



Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are a young, ambitious team, and we are looking for an A-player to help us scale our operations and optimize our profitability.





The Role: Mission

To take full ownership of Reformly’s financial administration and daily logistics, bringing impeccable accuracy, proactive communication, and structured execution to our processes in order to drive operational efficiency and profitability.





Tasks & Responsibilities

As our Finance & Operations Assistant, you will sit at the intersection of numbers and logistics. Your day-to-day will involve:

- Daily P&L Management: Keeping the daily Profit & Loss statements 100% up-to-date and accurate, with zero backlog.



- Invoice & Cost Auditing: Rigorously checking invoices and cost breakdowns to identify and resolve any discrepancies or errors.



- Data Entry & Calculations: Flawlessly inputting financial data and running ad-hoc cost calculations as needed.



- Order Fulfillment: Seamlessly managing daily order processing.



- Inventory Management: Maintaining an accurate, real-time inventory tracking sheet.



- Structured Reporting: Translating raw data into highly readable, organized updates for management.



- Proactive Issue Flagging: Immediately raising a red flag when processes slow down, numbers are off, or margins are at risk, and proactively bringing solutions.





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by results, not just hours worked. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive Profitability: Actively audit cost breakdowns, check invoices for discrepancies, and identify operational efficiencies to help realize a gross margin increase from 70% to 73%.



2. Financial Precision: Maintain a 100?curate, up-to-date Daily P&L and cost calculation spreadsheet, ensuring all data entry is processed flawlessly with zero backlog at the end of each week.



3. Fulfillment & Inventory Mastery: Achieve and maintain an average order-to-delivery time of 12 days or less by taking full ownership of daily fulfillment operations. Guarantee zero stockouts through meticulous inventory tracking.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Ownership & Autonomy: You do not need hand-holding or micro-management. You deeply understand the end goal and independently navigate the path to get there. You take full responsibility for outcomes, both successes and failures.



- High Standards & Attention to Detail: You are a healthy perfectionist. You inherently double-check work before submitting. You do not let small details, incorrect numbers, or minor logistical errors slip through the cracks.



- Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets. You can quickly process financial and operational data, spot trends, calculate costs accurately, and draw logical conclusions without getting overwhelmed.



- Organization & Structured Planning: You plan, organize, and schedule tasks in a highly efficient and productive manner. You bring order to chaos and naturally create systems to keep daily operations running smoothly.



- Proactivity & Problem Solving: You act without being told what to do. You can think critically outside the standard operating procedures (SOPs) when exceptions occur. You bring solutions to the table, not just problems.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not align with these:

- All-In Mentality (Impact Over Hours): We are not here just to collect a paycheck; we are here to achieve ambitious goals. You genuinely believe in what we are building and take deep pride in the results you deliver.



- Extreme Ownership (Radically Reliable): You understand that you are a crucial pillar of the team. When you take on a responsibility, the team can trust blindly that it will be executed flawlessly.



- Radical Candor (Direct & Transparent): No beating around the bush. We value efficient, clear, and straightforward communication. You are open, honest, and not afraid to give or receive direct feedback.



- High Velocity (Move Fast & Adapt): We are a young, fast-moving team. You thrive in a high-paced environment, pivot quickly when needed, and combine a sense of urgency with high execution power.



- Humble & Hungry (Continuous Growth): You bring positive energy. You are highly ambitious but leave your ego at the door. You are fiercely eager to learn, extremely coachable, and constantly looking to level up.





How to Apply

We do not want standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. Why you are a perfect fit for this specific role and our core values.

title: Chat Intake Training Manager
description:
About Juvo Leads

Juvo Leads is one of the fastest-growing live chat and legal intake companies in the United States. For more than 11 years, we have helped law firms connect with prospective clients through live chat, inbound call handling, appointment scheduling, and intake services.



Our primary focus is serving law firms nationwide, helping them create exceptional first impressions and convert more qualified prospects into clients.



While much of the industry continues to move toward automation, AI, and chatbots, our philosophy remains simple:

Butts in Seats. Not Bots in the Cloud.



We believe that when someone is searching for legal help, they deserve to interact with a real person. Every conversation we handle is powered by a trained human tea
mber—not artificial intelligence. Our commitment to genuine human interaction is what sets us apart and has fueled our growth for more than a decade.



As we continue to expand, we're building a world-class remote workforce capable of delivering exceptional service at scale. We are looking for leaders who are passionate about developing people, improving performance, and creating systems that help employees succeed.



If you're excited about building high-performing remote teams, developing talent, and creating measurable business impact through training and coaching, we'd love to meet you.



Overview

We are seeking a Training Manager to own the onboarding, development, certification, and ongoing education of our remote chat agent workforce. This role is responsible for ensuring every new hire receives a consistent, high-quality training experience and is fully prepared to succeed in production.



The Training Manager will design and deliver training programs, oversee agent readiness, partner with Operations and Quality teams to address performance gaps, and continuously improve learning initiatives that drive quality, efficiency, and client outcomes. This position is accountable not only for training delivery, but for the measurable success of agents after training.



The ideal candidate has experience building and managing remote training programs, coaching adult learners, developing curriculum, and creating scalable processes that support rapid organizational growth.



 Key Responsibilities: 



New Hire Training & Onboarding

  * Own the end-to-end onboarding and training experience for all new chat agents.

  * Design and deliver structured onboarding programs that prepare agents for legal intake and live chat responsibilities.

  * Ensure all new hires complete training, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * Conduct readiness assessments and certify agents before transition to production teams.

  * Facilitate seamless handoffs between Training, Operations, and Quality teams.



Training Program Development

  * Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for new and existing agents.

  * Develop lesson plans, training materials, SOPs, assessments, simulations, certifications, and knowledge base content.

  * Ensure training content remains current, accurate, and aligned with operational processes and client requirements.

  * Create scalable training systems capable of supporting company growth and new client launches.

  * Incorporate adult learning principles and instructional design best practices into all training initiatives.



Coaching & Employee Development

  * Deliver engaging virtual training sessions using a variety of learning methods and technologies.

  * Provide coaching, mentorship, and developmental feedback to employees throughout their tenure.

  * Partner with supervisors to identify employee skill gaps and create targeted development plans.

  * Build refresher training, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

  * Support career growth initiatives, internal promotions, and leadership development pathways.



Performance Assessment & Quality Improvement

  * Develop evaluation tools to measure trainee comprehension, readiness, and performance.

  * Track post-training performance to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, and operational performance metrics to identify training opportunities.

  * Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to reduce performance gaps and improve outcomes.

  * Ensure retraining initiatives are deployed quickly when performance concerns emerge. 



Collaboration & Program Management

  * Partner closely with Operations Leadership, Quality Assurance, and Client Services teams.

  * Support new client launches, process updates, script changes, and system enhancements through training initiatives.

  * Maintain accurate reporting on training completion, certifications, graduation rates, retention, and performance outcomes.

  * Establish best practices for knowledge transfer, coaching, documentation, and employee development.

  * Build and manage scalable training processes as the company continues to grow.



 Qualifications 



  Required 

  * Bachelor's degree in Education, Training & Development, Communications, Psychology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

  * Minimum 3 years of experience designing, delivering, and managing training programs in a fully remote environment with 50-100 employees. 

  * Proven experience onboarding, coaching, developing, and upskilling remote employees with teams of 50-100. 

  * Experience creating and maintaining virtual training curricula, certification programs, assessments, knowledge bases, SOPs, and continuing education programs.

  * Experience using remote training and knowledge management platforms such as Trainual, NotebookLM, Loom, Google Workspace, LMS platforms, testing tools, and virtual meeting software.

  * Experience in Live chat, Customer Service, Legal Intake, Contact Center Operations, Sales, Appointment Setting, or other performance-driven environments in the U.S. market. 

  * Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, coaching techniques, and performance management.

  * Demonstrated ability to provide performance coaching, career development guidance, and individualized improvement plans.

  * Experience partnering with Quality Assurance and Operations teams to identify skill gaps and implement training solutions.

  * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  * Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.

  * Ability to simplify complex concepts into engaging, actionable, and measurable learning experiences.

  * Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics, quality scores, and operational KPIs to evaluate training effectiveness.

  * Experience working with cross-functional, multinational teams supporting U.S.-based clients. 



 Preferred 

  * Experience in Legal Intake, Law Firm Operations, Legal Marketing, or Legal terminology.

  * Experience training and coaching remote teams in Live Chat, Customer Service, Contact Center, Intake, Sales, or Appointment-setting environments.

  * Experience building certification programs, mentorship initiatives, career progression frameworks, and leadership development programs.

  * Background in instructional design, learning and development, organizational development, or corporate training.

  * Experience creating video-based, self-paced, instructor-led, and blended learning programs.

  * Experience developing manager training and performance improvement programs.

  * Experience working in a startup, high-growth, or rapidly scaling organization.

  * Certifications in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Adult Learning, Coaching, Scrum, Agile, or related disciplines.

  * Extreme sense of ownership, pride and urgency- we move fast and are accountable to ourselves, our customers and our team. 



What Success Looks Like

The Training Manager owns the complete employee learning lifecycle, from onboarding through ongoing development. Success is measured not by training delivered, but by employee readiness, consistency, performance, and retention.



 New Hire Training & Onboarding 

  * All new hires complete onboarding, certification, and graduation requirements within established timelines.

  * New hires receive a consistent training experience regardless of trainer, start date, or training cohort.

  * Training classes are structured, organized, and delivered on schedule.

  * New hires demonstrate readiness before being released to production through documented assessments and certifications.

  * Agents are successfully transitioned into production teams with clear supervisor handoffs and performance expectations.



Performance & Development

  * New hires achieve expected quality and productivity metrics within established ramp periods.

  * Quality trends, recurring errors, and performance gaps are proactively identified and addressed through targeted training initiatives.

  * Refresher training and continuing education programs are delivered consistently.

  * Career development pathways support employee growth, internal promotions, and leadership development.



Training Program Ownership

  * Training materials, SOPs, certifications, knowledge bases, and assessments remain current and aligned with operational requirements.

  * New client launches, process updates, and operational changes are incorporated into training before impacting production performance.

  * Training programs scale effectively to support company growth and hiring demands.

  * Strong partnerships are maintained across Operations, Quality, and Leadership teams to continuously improve employee performance and client outcomes.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

   * Onboarding & Graduation

         * 95%+ New Hire Training Completion Rate

         * 95%+ Training Completion Within Established Timelines

         * 90%+ Certification Pass Rate

         * 90%+ Graduation Rate

         * 100% Readiness Assessments Completed Prior to Production Release



Retention & Performance

         * 85%+ New Hire 30-Day Retention Rate

         * New hires achieve expected productivity and quality benchmarks within established ramp schedules

         * Measurable reduction in repeat QA errors month-over-month

          * 100% Completion of Required Retraining Initiatives



Program Management

  * Training materials updated within 3 days of approved process changes

  * 100% Training readiness for new client launches and operational rollouts

  * Monthly reporting on training completion, certification results, retention, quality trends, and development initiatives



Ownership

   The Training Manager is responsible for:

         * New hire onboarding and orientation

         * Curriculum development and maintenance

         * Training delivery and facilitation

         * Certification and graduation processes

         * Production readiness assessments

         * Transition of agents into operational teams

         * Ongoing employee development and career coaching

         * Refresher training and retraining initiatives

         * Training documentation and knowledge management

         * Measuring and improving performance outcomes after training



 Benefits & Perks 

At Juvo Leads, we believe great people deserve a great place to work. We're a fast-growing, fully remote team that values collaboration, accountability, and a positive work environment where your ideas and contributions matter.



Compensation & Schedule

  * Pay: $9.00 USD per hour

  * Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

  * Some evenings and weekends will be required to support training initiatives within our 24/7 operation.

  * Bi-weekly payments via Wise



Premium Pay

  * Overtime: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked over 80 in a pay period

  * Holiday Pay: 1.5x hourly rate for hours worked on designated company holidays after 8 hours worked



Paid Time Off

  * 10 hours of PTO accrued per month

  * Any unused accrued PTO will be paid out on the first payroll of the calendar year.



Health & Technology

  * $80/month HMO stipend

  * $200 Welcome Technology Bonus

  * $100 Annual Equipment Bonus



Why You'll Love Working Here

*  100% remote position

*  Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing legal intake companies in the United States

*  Collaborative, supportive, and people-first culture

*  Comprehensive training documentation, SOPs, and knowledge management resources to set you up for success

*  Opportunity to make a meaningful impact by building and improving our training programs

*  Work alongside talented professionals across the United States and Latin America

*  A company that values innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and promoting from within



If you’re someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to stay ahead of the game, we want to hear from you.

Send your application to 
 and be part of our growing team at Juvo Leads! (as we do not check OLJ daily)

Please use the subject line “JUVO LEADS - CHAT INTAKE TRAINING MANAGER” when submitting your application. Thank you!

title: Patient Care Specialist
description:
Position Title: Patient Care Plan Specialist



Please submit a ONE-MINUTE VIDEO INTRODUCTION describing your experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or patients. Failure to submit will not be considered.



Qualified applicants will be contacted for the next steps in the selection process.





Position Overview:



United Chronic Care Management (UCCM) is seeking a compassionate, patient-focused, and highly organized Patient Navigation Specialist to help patients transform assessment findings into clear, actionable plans that support their health and wellness goals.



This role serves as a critical bridge between assessment and action. After patients complete their health assessments, the Patient Care Plan Specialist works closely with them to identify priorities, establish meaningful goals, develop individualized care plans, and create a personalized "My Plan" that outlines the steps, services, and resources needed to achieve desired outcomes.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who is skilled at coaching, active listening, and patient engagement. This individual must be able to guide patients through goal-setting conversations, help them understand their care options, and develop practical action plans that align with their needs, preferences, and circumstances.



This role is not simply documenting patient information—it is helping patients create a roadmap for success by turning assessment results into achievable goals, structured care plans, and coordinated next steps.





Core Mission of the Role:



To empower patients to take an active role in their health by developing personalized goals, creating comprehensive care plans, and guiding them through the next steps necessary to improve their health outcomes and overall well-being.





Primary Responsibilities:



- Care Plan Development



Develop individualized care plans based on assessment findings and patient goals.

Identify appropriate interventions, services, and support strategies to address patient needs.

Ensure care plans are practical, achievable, and aligned with the patient's priorities.

Regularly review and update care plans as patient needs and goals evolve.



- Goal Setting



Facilitate collaborative goal-setting conversations with patients.

Help patients establish realistic, measurable, and meaningful short-term and long-term health goals.

Assist patients in prioritizing goals based on their needs, readiness, and circumstances.

Encourage accountability and patient ownership of their health journey.



- My Plan Creation & Action Planning



Create personalized "My Plan" documents that serve as a roadmap for each patient.

Clearly outline patient goals, action steps, recommended services, follow-up activities, and expected outcomes.

Educate patients on their care plans and ensure they understand their next steps.

Help patients navigate and coordinate the services necessary to support their goals.



- Documentation & Compliance



Accurately document assessments, care plans, patient goals, progress notes, and follow-up activities.

Maintain HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.

Follow organizational policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Contribute to continuous improvement efforts focused on patient engagement and outcomes.





Desired Qualifications:



Experience in healthcare, care coordination, patient navigation, health coaching, case management, or a related field.

Strong communication, coaching, and motivational interviewing skills.

Ability to build rapport and engage patients from diverse backgrounds.

Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Ability to develop structured care plans and action-oriented patient goals.



Success in This Role Looks Like:



Patients have clearly defined and measurable health goals.

Personalized "My Plan" documents are completed accurately and on time.

Care plans are actionable, patient-centered, and regularly updated.

Patients understand their next steps and remain engaged in their care journey.

Improved patient participation, adherence, and progress toward desired outcomes.



Work Schedule



Work hours are aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business operations.

Specific shifts will be assigned during onboarding.

title: Steel Estimator
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Steel Estimator with experience in miscellaneous and structural steel fabrication. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working with precision, and can confidently manage multiple estimating projects from takeoff through bid preparation.



This is a part-time opportunity, perfect for an experienced estimator looking for flexible work while contributing to high-impact projects.



Core Responsibilities



Estimating & Project Analysis



• Analyze blueprints, specifications, contract documents, and project requirements to determine labor, material, and timeline needs. 

• Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for miscellaneous and structural steel projects, including stairs, railings, tanks, hoppers, chutes, and other fabricated steel components. 

• Prepare accurate cost estimates, bid proposals, and scopes of work. 

• Review project documents to identify potential risks, exclusions, and conditions that may impact project scope and pricing. 

• Develop value-engineered solutions and cost-saving recommendations where appropriate. 



Project Coordination & Documentation



• Manage drawing reviews and submittals from internal review through fabrication release. 

• Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors to obtain complete and competitive pricing. 

• Maintain estimating databases, bid records, and project documentation. 

• Support proposal development and business growth initiatives through accurate and timely estimating. 



Required Qualifications & Skills



• Minimum of 5 years of experience in miscellaneous metals and/or structural steel estimating. 

• Strong ability to perform accurate quantity takeoffs and material takeoffs. 

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents. 

• Strong understanding of general conditions and project requirements that may impact scope, scheduling, and pricing. 

• Experience using estimating software, Bluebeam, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Word. 

• Excellent organizational, analytical, and time management skills. 

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to estimate accuracy. 

• Ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously. 



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience using Tekla EPM, Tekla Estimating, Tekla PowerFab Estimating, or Tekla Modeling. 

• Experience working with parametric assemblies within Tekla estimating environments. 

• Familiarity with industry standards including AISC, AWS, NOMMA, AESS, and SSPC. 

• Experience with complex, custom, or large-scale steel fabrication projects. 

• Background in value engineering and cost optimization strategies. 

• Strong collaboration skills working with fabrication teams, project managers, vendors, and subcontractors. 



Work Schedule



• Part-Time 

• CST Time Zone 

• Flexible working arrangement based on project workload 



Why This Role Matters



This position plays a critical role in ensuring accurate project costing, competitive bids, and profitable project execution. Your expertise will directly contribute to the success of fabrication projects while supporting the company's growth and long-term client relationships.



How to Apply



To apply, please submit:



• Updated Resume 

• A 60–90 second self-introduction video sharing your estimating experience and why you are a great fit for this role 

• Samples of previous work (takeoffs, estimates, bid packages, etc. — please remove or redact any confidential information) 



Note: Only applications submitted within 48–72 hours of this posting will be considered.

title: Operations Manager - Short-Term Rental Property Management
description:
Island Head Rentals manages ~45 short-term rental properties on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. We're hiring a remote Operations Manager to be the backbone of our operation — the person who leads our VA team, keeps maintenance moving across the portfolio, and delivers clear reporting to our property owners.



This is a senior, long-term, direct-hire role for someone we can keep and grow with for years. You'll own processes and relationships, not just execute tasks.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead the VA team: oversee our guest-communications VAs, set daily priorities, monitor quality, keep everyone on our SOPs, and handle escalations.

- Coordinate maintenance: triage maintenance issues across ~45 properties, dispatch and follow up with vendors and our handyman, track every work order to completion, and keep owners in the loop.

- Build owner reporting: produce accurate monthly owner statements and performance reports from our property management system (Guesty), presented so owners actually understand them.

- Own the operational cadence: keep guest comms, owner outreach, balance collection, and turnovers running on schedule, and catch problems before they reach a guest.

- Improve the system: refine SOPs and propose fixes for recurring issues.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Short-term rental / property management operations experience (Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty). Guesty experience strongly preferred.

- Real leadership experience — you've managed people or a remote team and can hold others accountable firmly and kindly.

- Strong reporting skills — comfortable in spreadsheets/Excel and turning platform data into clean owner-facing reports.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Sound judgment and calm under pressure; you know when to d
 and when to escalate.

- Reliable availability during US Eastern business hours.

- Extremely organized and dependable — this is the role the whole operation leans on.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with OpenPhone or similar

- Vendor / maintenance coordination background

- Experience supporting a US-based property management company



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "HARBOR" so we know you read the full post. In a few sentences, tell us about a time you managed a team or a vendor situation that was going badly and how you turned it around. Please also include your STR/PM experience, your availability in US Eastern time, and the reporting tools you've used.

title: AI Video Editor — DTC Performance Ads (Hourly, Remote)
description:
We're a UK-based DTC brand in the pet health space — premium supplements for ageing dogs. This is in-house, working directly with the founder. Not agency work, not a content mill.



We make performance ads: AI-generated footage, real footage sourced from social, and competitors footage, cut into ads that stop the scroll and sell. If you cut wedding films or corporate explainers, this isn't your role. If you've made DTC ads that had to actually convert, keep reading. This posting is long on purpose — how you respond to it tells us more than your CV will.

The work



Most ads are 15–45 seconds. Some fully AI-generated, some built from real footage pulled off TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, most a mix. The skill is knowing which approach each brief needs and executing so the viewer can't tell what's AI and what isn't. 



We build mostly in Google Flow (Veo) and think it's the strongest tool going right now. Runway, Kling, whatever's current — if something better lands next month, we expect you to find it.



For most of the content we make, If it looks like an ad, it's wrong. If it looks like something a real owner filmed at home with their own dog, it's right. You should also know which AI voice tools sound human and which kill an ad instantly, and understand that the first three seconds d
 whether anyone watches the other forty.



A live brief

An ad opens on an older dog pausing at the bottom of the stairs, hesitating before the climb — it has to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds. Walk us through how you'd make those three seconds. What's the first frame?



Experience

You should have made video ads for DTC or ecommerce brands — performance ads built to sell a product, not corporate videos, YouTube intros or wedding films. If your portfolio is all non-commercial work, we're probably not the right fit.



Hours and rate

Hourly to start, $5–8 depending on experience, roughly 10–20 hours a week. If the work is strong and consistent, this moves to part-time or full-time within a couple of months. We don't micromanage hours. We care about output and communication — show up, do great work, flag issues early.



How to apply

Don't send a CV or a cover letter. We don't read them. Send us:



One real DTC video ad you think was built to look real but still reads as AI. Paste the link and tell us in 2–3 sentences what gave it away and what you'd have done differently.



AI video always has tells. How do you get rid of them? Be specific and concise — techniques, tools, settings. We'd rather have three real ones than a list of ten.



Your approach to the staircase brief above.



Three ads you've made (links). For one, tell us what you'd redo today, and why.



One thing in this posting you think is wrong, or would push back on. We mean it — the best editors we've worked with always have an opinion.



For the subject line: skip the greeting and put the single AI video tool you'd bet on for the next twelve months, nothing else.

We read every application that follows this. The generic ones (no links, no opinion, no self-critique) take about ten seconds to spot, and we don't reply to those.



If you've read this far and something in it made you think yeah, I could do that — we'd love to hear from you. We're a small team, you'd be working directly with the founder, and if you're good, you'll have real ownership over the work and room to grow with us as we scale. Take your time with the application. We read every proper one, and we'll always reply to the people who clearly put the effort in.

title: Bookkeeper and Accounting Virtual Assistant
description:
A company in the health insurance industry is looking for a detail-oriented, Bookkeeper and Accounting Virtual Assistant to join a high-performing remote team. This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position operating on Central Standard Time (CST). We are building something great and need an A-Player who is ready to hit the ground running, go the extra mile, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.



This role is 100% remote.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We work in the accounting software (SaaS) space and are growing rapidly. You will be one of the first tea
mbers to learn and work within our proprietary accounting platform, REVREX. Your work will directly impact how we onboard and support new clients, and your feedback will help shape the product itself. If you love bookkeeping, enjoy solving problems, and communicate confidently in English, this is the opportunity for you.





RESPONSIBILITIES



- Learn and become proficient in our proprietary accounting software, REVREX

- Identify and report software bugs during hands-on use of the platform

- Assist in setting up accounts for incoming clients within the software

- Provide support and answer questions for newly onboarded clients

- Perform general bookkeeping tasks within the software on behalf of clients

- Communicate effectively with clients and teammates in English

- Work flexible hours as needed to meet client and business demands

- Maintain accuracy and organization across all bookkeeping and client tasks

- Contribute actively to a collaborative, fast-paced team environment





QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO certification is required, though QBO will not be used in this role — the experience and certification demonstrate your bookkeeping foundation)

- Fluent in both English (spoken and written)

- Clear and professional speaking accent suitable for client-facing communication

- Strong understanding of general bookkeeping principles and accounting workflows

- Quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes

- Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills

- Ability to work full-time (40 hours per week) on a CST schedule

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

- Proactive, reliable, and genuinely invested in doing excellent work

- Prior experience in a virtual assistant or remote work setting is a plus





POSITION DETAILS



Type: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Central Standard Time (CST)

Setup: 100% Remote

Target Start Date: On or around July 9th (please note the onboarding process may take up to 3 weeks)





HOW TO APPLY

- Updated Resume

- Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is perfectly fine)



Applications that are missing any of the above will not be reviewed. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST — HEALTH & BEAUTY FACEBOOK ADS (ANGLES, DIRECT RESPONSE)
description:
Please read the full post before applying. Experienced direct-response creative strategists only.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-scaling health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads. We are adding a Creative Strategist to lead a creative pod as we scale.



In our model, one strategist works with two image ad creators and owns the creative direction for a set of stores. Your job is to find winning angles, own the ad copy and the advertorial landing page, and keep a steady flow of new concepts that our image ad creators turn into ads.



This is a long-term, full-time remote role for someone who thinks in angles and hooks, understands direct-response and advertorial funnels, and knows Meta compliance for health and beauty.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Find winning angles, meaning genuinely new creative concepts that become profitable and hold, not new versions of angles that already won.

- Own the ad copy and the advertorial landing page for your products.

- Research competitor ads and swipes to build strong angles, and direct your two image ad creators on what to build.

- Keep iterating on proven winners while continuing to find new golden angles to scale for months.

- Keep every angle runnable and compliant with Meta for health and beauty, so we protect our account trust scores.

- Work closely with the media buying team and adjust based on performance.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Real experience doing creative strategy for ecommerce or dropshipping brands. Health and beauty is a big plus.

- Strong at angles and hooks, advertorial funnels, and direct-response copy.

- You can research swipes and competitor ads and turn them into fresh, winning concepts.

- Solid understanding of Meta compliance for health and beauty (aggressive claims, cure or treatment claims, unrealistic timelines) and how to stay compliant without overpushing.

- Comfortable directing image ad creators and leading a small creative pod.

- Available full-time and for long-term cooperation.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience writing advertorials and offer pages.

- Experience with UK and EU markets.

- A portfolio of angles or ads that scaled.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word ANGLE so we know you read the full post.



Then answer the questions below clearly. Real examples and real proof matter more than general statements.



1. How many years have you done creative strategy for ecommerce or dropshipping? Was any of it in health and beauty?

2. What do you mean by a winning angle? Share one you found that scaled and why it worked.

3. How do you research swipes and competitor ads to build new angles, and how many swipes do you pull per product?

4. Do you write ad copy and advertorial landing pages? Please share examples.

5. What do you know about Meta compliance for health and beauty, and how do you keep angles runnable without hurting trust scores?

6. Have you directed image ad creators or led a small creative team?

7. How do you d
 when to iterate on a proven winner versus find a new angle?

8. Please share your CV and a portfolio of angles, ads, or landing pages you have worked on.

9. Are you available full-time and long-term? What are your working hours and timezone?

10. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



We review every application that follows these instructions and are looking for someone who can start soon.

title: Viral Social Media Strategist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for someone who thinks about content differently.



Your job is not to make content that gets views.



Your job is to figure out what videos should exist to generate sales, then create the strategy, scripts, and storyboards that make those videos possible.



Everything you do should be based on customer psychology, data, and testing. Not opinions.



You'll analyze what is working, identify opportunities, and continually improve our content strategy based on results.



What You'll Do



* Identify content opportunities that are likely to generate revenue.

* Determine whether we need more top, middle, or bottom of funnel content to result in sales

* Analyze customer awareness levels, angles, and market sophistication to d
 what messaging will work best.

* Build content strategies based on data instead of trends.

* Write short-form video scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, YouTube Shorts, and Meta / Tiktok Ads

* Create simple storyboards/ descrive what should be happening in each frame that explain each scene of the video.

* Develop strong hooks that stop people from scrolling.

* Plan calls-to-action that naturally move viewers toward becoming customers.

* Review analytics to understand why videos succeed or fail.

* Recommend new tests based on previous results.

* Build repeatable content systems instead of chasing viral trends.

* Maintains organization and full control of tests done



You Should Understand



* Direct response marketing

* Customer awareness levels

* Market sophistication

* What good top, middle, and bottom of funnel content looks like

* Customer objections

* Desire-based marketing

* Research to find angles for marketing

* Offer positioning

* Hooks and retention

* Script writing

* Storyboarding

* Consumer psychology

* A/B testing

* Organic social media strategy

* Ads testing strategy

* Content that generates sales instead of just engagement



Success Looks Like



You don't celebrate a video because it reached 500,000 views.

You celebrate it because it generated customers.



Every recommendation should answer questions like:



* Why should we make this video?

* Who is it for?

* What stage of awareness is this person in?

* What objection does this solve?

* Where does this fit in the funnel?

* What result are we expecting?

* How will we know if it worked?



Ideal Candidate



* Thinks analytically and enjoys solving marketing problems.

* Is used to strategising and creating scripts for content

* Makes decisions using numbers and evidence.

* Has experience writing high-converting short-form video scripts.

* Understands direct response copywriting.

* Can explain why a piece of content should work before it is created.

* Is comfortable testing ideas and changing strategy when the data says to.

* Enjoys researching customer psychology and buying behavior.

* Has excellent written English.



Bonus Skills



Application



Please include:

1. Examples of content strategies and scripts you've created.

2. Three short-form videos you believe generated sales (and explain why).

3. A short explanation of the difference between top, middle, and bottom of funnel content.

4. Your favorite marketing book and why.

5. Your favorite marketer and why.

6. How you would d
 whether our next 20 videos should target awareness, consideration, or conversion.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

 and Instagram/Facebook DM enquiries

You'll have a custom AI assistant (built on Claude) that knows every product, spec, price and delivery time. Your job is to be the warm human who guides the customer — the AI handles the technical brain.



Who we're looking for



Fluent, natural, comfortable English — written and spoken. You'll be on the phone with UK customers every day. Native-level written English is essential. Accent doesn't matter; clarity and warmth do.

2–5 years of consultative sales experience, ideally in a considered-purchase category (education, luxury, kitchen appliances, fitness equipment, home, or similar). Pottery knowledge is NOT required.
