You are not here to make the creative. You are here to make the creative machine run. Capacity, output, deadlines, and people.



This is a leadership role. You are trusted to own outcomes, not be micromanaged on tasks.

If you prefer a task-only execution role, this is not for you.



This role lives in the numbers. You'll own our creative dashboard entirely, and at any 
nt you'll know who has room for more work, who's overloaded, and what's at risk of slipping, before anyone asks.



You don't manage from a distance. You catch problems early, confront underperformance head-on, and make tough people decisions with confidence.



Full ownership is the goal. This role is measured by one thing: how efficiently you scale creative output without sacrificing quality.





What You’ll Own:



The Dashboard and Capacity Planning

- Own the creative ops dashboard: capacity, utilization, deadlines, and workload.

- Track output per editor and per project. Spot bottlenecks before they hit.

- Forecast production and hiring needs weekly and monthly.

- Bring leadership data-backed recommendations, not opinions.

- When a number drops, you find the leak and have a fix in place.



The Team

- Directly manage the video editing team, with copywriters in scope when needed.

- Run interviews and assess talent well. Hiring is core to this role.

- Run one-on-ones and performance reviews.

- Hold people accountable. When someone underperforms, name the problem, set a clear path with a deadline, and if they don't hit it, make the call yourself.



Process, Systems, and AI

- Audit and rebuild outdated workflows and SOPs across the creative pipeline.

- Every project has an owner, a deadline, and a status. You enforce all three.

- Use AI daily to multiply output: SOPs, data analysis, automation, reports, forecasting.

- Grow capacity without growing headcount.

- Strong with spreadsheets and automation tools.

- Keep individual contributors, managers, and leadership in sync so production never stops.





Must-Haves:

- 3+ years in operations or team management, ideally overseeing creative or production teams.

- Highly analytical and obsessed with numbers. Capacity planning, utilization, and performance metrics are your comfort zone.

- Direct communicator who doesn’t avoid conflict. You address problems head-on and don’t let issues sit.

- Comfortable making difficult people decisions, including terminations, and experienced in doing so.

- Proven experience running structured interviews and hiring.

- Data fluent. Strong in spreadsheets, and you know when to use a median over an average.

- Technical enough to work with automation tools, scripts, and developers, and to pick up new software fast.

- Heavy, hands-on use of AI in daily ops work. You can name what you use and why.

- Extremely organized and process-oriented. Nothing sits, nothing waits, and you always know who’s stuck and on what.

- Strong written and spoken English. You’ll run meetings, hold people accountable, and write SOPs.

- Daily overlap from 1 PM to 10 PM Manila time (GMT+8), and reachable when urgent issues come up.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience managing video editors, designers, or other creative production teams at scale.

- Experience building or owning a capacity or KPI dashboard.

- Strong experience inside ClickUp, Notion, Airtable, 
, or similar.

- Experience building AI workflows or automations.

- Basic understanding of video production workflows. You don’t need to edit, you need to know what “done” and “good” look like.



How we hire is fast and respectful of your time

1. Fill out our quick form. Simple questions, ~5 minutes.

2. We reply to every single person who applies. No ghosting.

3. Pass the first round ? a short interview to ensure culture fit 

4. Past the first interview ? a short  technical interview. 

4. Crush it ? we send you an offer.



What you get when you go full-time (after a 1 to 2 month probation):

We genuinely take care of our team.

- Salary raise above your starting pay

- 13th-month pay

- 18 days paid time off + holidays

- Every AI tool you need, paid by us

- Health insurance

- Annual training/learning budget

- A chance to fly out and meet the rest of the team (totally optional)





We invest hard in our people. We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term.



Apply now. It takes 5 minutes.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the full bookkeeping function — managing accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, payroll processing, BAS preparation, financial reporting, and general ledger maintenance.



Please send your CV and answer the following:

How long have you been supporting Australian (AU)-based clients?

Please list the accounting software you have used.



Required

• Demonstrated bookkeeping experience supporting Australian businesses — essential

• Proficient in Xero, MYOB, and/or QuickBooks — experience with at least one platform required, multiple preferred

• Strong understanding of Australian GST, BAS, and ATO compliance requirements• Experience processing Australian payroll including superannuation, STP, and Fair Work entitlements

• Accurate and detail-oriented across all bookkeeping functions — bank reconciliations, AP/AR, payroll, and reporting

• Able to work independently and manage the bookkeeping function with minimal supervision

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills for correspondence with clients and accountants



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Bank Reconciliation

• Process and manage accounts payable — entering supplier invoices, scheduling payments, and reconciling creditor accounts

• Manage accounts receivable — raising and sending invoices, tracking outstanding payments, and following up overdue accounts

• Perform regular bank reconciliations across all business accounts, ensuring all transactions are correctly coded and reconciled

• Maintain the general ledger with accurate coding of income, expenses, and balance sheet items

• Reconcile credit card statements and other financial accounts on a regular basis



Payroll, BAS & Compliance

• Process fortnightly or monthly payroll accurately in accordance with Australian payroll requirements, Fair Work obligations, and

applicable Awards

• Calculate and process superannuation contributions, ensuring correct SG rates are applied and payments are made on time

• Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS) in accordance with ATO requirements

• Assist with Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and ensure payroll records are accurate and compliant

• Maintain up-to-date records of employee entitlements including annual leave, personal leave, and long service leave balances



Financial Reporting & General Bookkeeping

• Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and cash flow reports for management review

• Assist with end-of-month and end-of-year close processes, ensuring all accounts are reconciled and accurate

• Maintain organised and audit-ready financial records across all bookkeeping systems

• Liaise with the client's external accountant, providing accurate financial data and supporting documentation as required

• Identify and flag discrepancies, unusual transactions, or bookkeeping issues to the business owner or accountant proactively

title: AI Video Editor (Paid Ad Creatives)
description:

Who We're Looking For



One golden rule at our company: you must have the DESIRE to learn & grow. If you're not passionate about getting better every week, this isn't the place for you.



The purpose of this role isn't just editing videos — it's learning how to edit for performance. You'll learn how hooks grab attention, how emotional pacing drives watch time, and how the right angle maximizes ROAS. We'll train you on the marketing side — you bring the hunger.



You're a great fit if you:



- Love editing videos and want to get seriously good at it

- Are curious about what makes ads actually convert

- Take feedback well and move fast on revisions

- Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

- Want to grow into a Creative Strategist role over time (not necessary)



What You'll Do Day-to-Day

- Add text overlays, captions, cuts, and pacing optimized for ads

- Make revisions based on internal feedback

- Keep files and exports organized for the team

- Attend weekly learning check-ins



Required:



- Experience with Video Editing ads (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

- Clear written English

- Ability to follow instructions and hit deadlines

- Open & Curious to Feedback and Revisions

- Organised and reliable



Why Join Us?



- Bonuses & Profit Share — You'll earn bonuses tied to the performance of ads you help create. When your work converts, you get rewarded.

- Real Training — Not just video editing. We'll train you on ad structures, creative strategy, and how to edit for results. You'll learn marketing fundamentals most junior editors never get exposed to.

- Growth Path — There's a clear path from Junior Editor ? Creative Strategist based on performance. We promote from within.



How Does This Work?



We hold our team to high standards and reward great work — expect your rates to grow as you do. Here's our simple hiring process:



- Send a short intro video about yourself and your experience,

- A portfolio or samples of video edits (ads preferred)

- Culture and Values Interview

title: Freelance Brand Identity, Packaging & Digital Designer
description:
Premium Home & Lifestyle Product Launch (Project-Based)



1. Overview



We are looking for an experienced freelance Brand & Packaging Designer to help bring a premium home and lifestyle product to market.



This is a project-based engagement where you'll develop a complete, cohesive brand identity and apply it across every customer touchpoint—from physical packaging to website assets, social media, and marketing materials.



We already have some initial design directions and inspiration. We're looking for a designer who can build upon these foundations and create a distinctive, ownable brand system that feels premium, elevated, bold, and playful while standing out in a competitive market.



We're looking for someone who can think strategically about branding while also delivering exceptional execution across both print and digital.



2. About the Product



Product: Multi-functional ergonomic intimacy & back support pillow with a complementary support kit



Category:  Home & Lifestyle



What it is



A premium ergonomic pillow designed to provide support during intimate 
nts, while also functioning as a comfortable relaxation and back support pillow. The accompanying kit contains complementary products that enhance the overall experience both inside and outside the bedroom.



Target Customer



Primarily couples seeking premium wellness and intimacy products.



Brand Positioning



Premium, elevated, modern and design-driven.



What Makes It Different



* Unique ergonomic shape

* Beautiful aesthetic design

* Premium supporting accessories

* Strong emphasis on branding and customer experience



Competitive References



* Liberator Pillow

* Tabu Prim Pillow

* Moodie Pillow



Every design decision should support the positioning of a premium, memorable lifestyle brand.





3. Project Objectives



The final brand should:



* Feel premium, modern and thoughtfully designed

* Have a bold, playful personality that makes it memorable

* Be instantly recognizable across packaging, website and social media

* Perform equally well on physical products and digital platforms

* Include clear brand guidelines for future product expansion

* Provide a complete production-ready design system that can scale as the business grows





4. Existing Assets



We already have:



* Initial visual direction

* Mood boards and inspiration

* Color preferences

* Product references



These should be treated as a starting point rather than limitations. We're open to evolving the existing direction if there is a strong creative rationale.





 5. Scope of Work



Phase 1 – Brand Identity & Guidelines



Develop a complete visual identity for the brand, including:



* Logo system (primary, secondary and responsive versions)

* Color palette for print and digital

* Typography system

* Photography and art direction

* Illustration and icon style

* Brand personality and tone of voice

* Comprehensive brand guidelines including:



  * Logo usage

  * Color specifications

  * Typography hierarchy

  * Spacing

  * Do's and don'ts

  * Future product applications





Phase 2 – Packaging & Web Application



Create a premium packaging system that reflects the brand identity.



Deliverables include:



Packaging



* Primary product packaging

* Secondary packaging

* Shipping boxes

* Mailers

* Sleeves

* Multipacks



Provide:



* Print-ready artwork

* Correct dielines

* Bleeds

* Manufacturing specifications



Website & E-commerce



Create design direction for:



* Shopify

* Amazon



Including:



* Homepage styling

* Product pages

* Key design components

* Brand application guidelines



Final files should be delivered in Figma or another developer-friendly format.





Phase 3 – Social Media & Marketing Assets



Apply the brand across digital marketing.



Deliverables include:



Social Media



* Instagram templates

* Story templates

* Post templates

* Profile assets

* TikTok templates (if applicable)



Marketing Materials



Examples include:



* Digital advertisements

*
 headers

* Sales sheets

* One-page brochures

* Presentation deck template



All assets should follow the established brand system.



6. Project Timeline



Estimated timeline:



**Brand Discovery & Strategy**

Approximately 1–2 weeks



**Brand Identity**

Approximately 2 weeks



**Packaging Design**

Approximately 1 week



**Digital Application**

Approximately 2 weeks



**Total Project Duration**

Approximately 6–8 weeks



Up to three rounds of revisions are expected per phase, assuming timely feedback and communication.



7. Ownership & Deliverables



Upon completion of the project, all approved final artwork and editable source files will become the property of the client.



Please provide editable files where appropriate, including:



* Figma

* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe InDesign

* Canva (where applicable)



Along with print-ready and web-ready exports.







8. Communication



We value clear communication and collaboration throughout the project.



We expect regular progress updates and approximately three short check-ins per week to review milestones, discuss feedback, and ensure the project stays on schedule.





 9. What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who has:



* Strong experience creating premium brand identities

* Excellent packaging design skills

* Experience designing for both print and digital

* Strong typography and layout skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience preparing production-ready packaging files

* The ability to think strategically, not just visually



Experience with premium consumer products or lifestyle brands is highly desirable.







10. How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:



* A link to your portfolio (branding and packaging work preferred)

* A brief introduction about yourself

* A short explanation of how you would approach this project

* Your estimated timeline and availability

* The design tools you work with (Figma, Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, etc.)



Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an introductory interview.



We look forward to seeing your work and finding a creative partner to help bring this exciting brand to life.

You will be responsible for identifying commercially viable product ideas, managing the development process from concept to launch, and ensuring each product aligns with our brand identity while achieving profitability targets. This role requires a blend of analytical prowess, creative thinking, and a deep understanding of our customer avatar.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct comprehensive product research and keyword analysis to identify high-demand products that align with our brand and customer needs.

• Collaborate with the sourcing and production team to manage the end-to-end product development process, ensuring clear processes and timely results.

• Work closely with our China-based sourcing agent to identify supplier options and oversee sampling using the Ignite framework.

• Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers while maintaining a focus on win-win partnerships.

• Coordinate with freelance designers to create artwork and product designs as needed.

• Evaluate product samples for quality and functionality, ensuring adherence to specifications.

• Establish clear guidelines for product specifications and features, collaborating with the content team for packaging and listing creation.

• Monitor product workflow and deadlines, ensuring that products move through the development process efficiently.

• Validate product concepts through customer feedback and iterate based on insights gained.



EXPECTED RESULTS:

• Establish a product pipeline calendar for the next 12 months, facilitating strategic planning and manufacturing ramp-up.

• Development of products with potential for patent, trademark, or copyright protection to safeguard our brand from copycats.

• Meaningful product designs and features that resonate with our customer base.

• Clear understanding of capital requirements for product launches, supported by financial forecasts.

• Prediction of revenue growth from new products, enabling strategic decision-making for acquiring debt if necessary.

• Identify optimal factories for product manufacturing based on the variety of products in the pipeline.

• Validate new products through customer avatar feedback to ensure a high probability of success.

• Delivery of products that meet customer needs and elevate brand awareness.

• Development of intellectual property elements to defend against competitors.



REQUIREMENTS:

• Deep understanding of our customer avatar and their product preferences.

• Creative mindset with the ability to develop impactful product concepts.

• Strong organizational skills to manage multiple products in development simultaneously.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in English, both spoken and written.

• Proficiency in tools such as Asana, Slack, Excel, Google Suite, Office, and Loom.

• Must be willing to work in the EST time zone and comfortable using a time tracker

title: Aircraft Records Specialist
description:
**Aircraft Records Specialist (Remote, Contract)**



**About Radar**



Radar digitizes and connects aircraft maintenance records. We take scanned paper logbooks, manuals, STCs, and FAA documents and turn them into structured, searchable records, total times and cycles, AD and SB compliance, inspections, life-limited parts, and 8130-3 release tags, all tied to the actual aircraft.



Operators, owners, lenders, and buyers use Radar to query their records, prove compliance, and return aircraft to service faster. Our AI does the first pass on every page. Your job is to make sure it's right.



**The role**



You'll work inside Radar's Logbook Viewer to review, correct, and QA the records our AI extracts from each aircraft's logbooks. We measure work in "tails" — one tail is one aircraft's complete records, and a single tail can run to thousands of scanned pages. Accuracy and consistency matter more than raw speed. For each tail you will:



- **Classify documents -** confirm or correct each document's type and content (Logbook Entry / service record, Authorized Release Certificate / 8130-3, Work Order, 8110, 337, shipping documents, etc) and flag Unclassified or Junk. Clear the Unclassified queue so nothing is left ambiguous.

- **Link and organize pages -** move mis-grouped page sections into the right document; split or merge so each real-world record (e.g. an 8130 tag stapled to a page) is its own clean entry.

- **Attach records to the right aircraft -** verify the tail / N-number and reassign when the AI guessed wrong.

- **Verify extracted data -** check extracted fields against the source image: dates, airframe/engine/APU/propeller total time and cycles (TSN/CSN), part numbers and serials, repair station and signatures.

- **Review and sign off -** mark each document Reviewed, comment on anything ambiguous, and flag documents that can serve as public compliance evidence.



**A typical week**



You process a batch of new logbooks yourself and QA a batch that's ready to ship. You escalate the genuinely ambiguous records instead of guessing, and you help make the next hundred tails go smoother than the last by flagging patterns the AI keeps getting wrong.



**What we're looking for**



- **Aviation records familiarity -** you can look at a logbook entry, an 8130-3, or a work order and know what it is and what matters on it. Fits: A&P mechanic, aircraft records clerk, Director of Maintenance, Part 145 repair-station records, or back-to-birth records research. A current certificate is a plus, not a requirement.

- **Meticulous and consistent -** you notice a tail number off by a digit, and apply the same rules on page 8,000 as on page 1.

- **Strong written English -** you'll read US/FAA documents and write clear review comments.

- **Comfortable in web software -** you'll live in a browser-based review tool all day.

- **Reliable and communicative -** you own a queue and a turnaround time, and you flag slippage early. This matters to us more than anything else here.

- **~4+ hours daily overlap with US business hours (ET).**



**Nice to have**



ADs, Service Bulletins, ATA chapters, life-limited parts, Form 337, or pre-buy / back-to-birth records research. Experience QAing others' work or writing SOPs — we're early and small, and the right person can help shape how records get processed and checked.



**Logistics**



- Contract, paid monthly. Remote - with US ET overlap preferred for timezone.

- ~Full-time, flexible, with daily US overlap. Part-time considered for strong aviation-domain candidates.

- Compensation: ~$1,000/month is our benchmark for an experienced records person.

- Start immediately. Long-term role; strong performers can grow into a lead/QA position that owns training and SOPs.



**How we hire**



1) Short application + a few questions on your aviation-records background. 2) A brief call. 3) A paid trial on one real tail — you'll classify, link, and QA a sample of pages in Radar so we both see how the work feels. Reliability and accuracy on the real tool matter more to us than a resume.



To apply: reply here with a short note on your aviation-records experience and your availability in US-ET hours.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure, keeping projects moving, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks. You'll work closely with leadership to support marketing initiatives, coordinate projects, manage documentation, and help build systems that allow the team to scale efficiently.



About the Role

As the Marketing Operations Assistant, you will provide day-to-day operational support across marketing projects by managing workflows, tracking deliverables, documenting meetings, coordinating communications, and maintaining internal systems.



You will work closely with leadership, helping transform discussions into actionable tasks while ensuring projects stay organized and on schedule.



Responsibilities:

Operational & Project Support

-Support daily operational execution across marketing initiatives

-Track project timelines, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies

-Monitor action items and ensure follow-through across the team

-Assist with coordinating priorities as projects evolve



Meeting Coordination & Documentation

-Attend internal, client, and partner meetings

-Take organized meeting notes and document key decisions

-Record meetings when required

-Convert discussions into actionable tasks and project updates



Communication Management

-Coordinate communication with clients, partners, and vendors

-Follow up on requests, updates, and outstanding action items

-Ensure stakeholders remain informed throughout project execution

-Help maintain smooth communication between departments



Systems & Organization

-Maintain and update project boards, documentation, and internal trackers

-Keep workflows organized and current

-Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and documentation

-Ensure files and project assets remain organized and accessible



Administrative Support

-Assist with organizing and tracking contracts and operational documents

-Maintain accurate records and internal documentation

-Support administrative tasks that improve team efficiency



Research & General Support

-Conduct research to support marketing and operational initiatives

-Assist with miscellaneous projects as business priorities change

-Provide support wherever needed to keep projects moving forward



Required Skills:

Technical Skills

-Familiarity with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and Microsoft Excel

-Experience using Notion or similar project management tools is an advantage

-Comfortable working with digital collaboration and productivity tools

-Exposure to marketing or creative workflows is a plus, but not required



Soft Skills

-Strong organizational instincts—you naturally bring structure and clarity to your work

-Comfortable managing multiple projects and shifting priorities simultaneously

-Exceptional attention to detail with strong follow-through

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills

-Able to work independently, take initiative, and solve problems proactively

-Comfortable asking questions, speaking up, and flagging issues early

-Fast learner who adapts quickly as priorities and processes evolve



Preferred Qualifications

-Interest or background in Operations, Project Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or Law

-Previous experience supporting marketing, operations, or project management teams is an advantage

-Experience working with remote teams and collaborative workflows is a plus



Why You'll Love This Role

-Work directly with leadership and gain firsthand experience in how operations drive business growth

-Support fast-moving brands and creators on meaningful, real-world projects

-Learn how marketing, operations, and execution come together to build scalable systems

-Be part of a collaborative team that values ownership, trust, and continuous improvement

-Gain exposure to real client work and opportunities to grow your skills and responsibilities



Personality Fit

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing order to fast-moving environments. You naturally stay organized, think ahead, and enjoy helping teams work more efficiently. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly, and find satisfaction in building systems that make everyone more productive.



If you enjoy solving operational challenges, supporting leadership, and making sure projects move forward without missing the details, we'd love to hear from you.



How to Apply

Please send the following:

Updated Resume

title: (No Accent) Sales Development Representative - Cold Calling / Live Transfers
description:

You will be speaking with small business owners, following a simple script, qualifying interest, and transitioning leads to a Zoom call to close on a $800 frontend offer. From there, a closer will take over on our high end product. 



This is a great role for someone who is confident on the phone, speaks clear and easy-to-understand English, and wants a straightforward sales role with weekly pay, commission upside, and room to grow.

$10 / hour base pay

$200 commission bonus structure on closed deals

Paid weekly

Schedule



Remote position

How Success Is Measured



Call volume

Conversations with business owners

Qualified live transfers

Closed deals

Consistency and reliability

title: Video Editor & Content VA Flexible hours with PST overlap
description:
Hiring a Video Editor & Content VA with at least 2 years of experience editing videos and creating simple graphics for social media, YouTube, and online marketing content. Need someone who can manually edit videos, create thumbnails or basic graphics, follow instructions, and publish content on schedule. 



Experience using AI video or content tools is an advantage, but not required. We are more interested in strong editing skills, reliability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn. Training, examples, and clear instructions will be provided.



Important Note on Working Hours

During the initial onboarding period, there will be an expected PST overlap with the team to allow real-time collaboration, feedback, and training. After onboarding, the workflow will become more structured and task-based.



Responsibilities

1. Edit videos for YouTube, social media, and online marketing campaigns

2. Add captions, text, music, cuts, transitions, and basic visual effects

3. Create simple thumbnails, graphics, and social media images

4. Follow a content calendar and publish content online

5. Work closely with the business owner and follow set processes

6. Use tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or similar apps

7. Learn and use AI video/content tools where helpful, without relying on them completely



Applications that do not follow instructions will not be considered. Send Us the Following:

- Link to your updated resume

- Link to your video editing portfolio

- Links to 2–3 sample video edits or social media projects you created

- A short 60–90 second video introduction explaining why you would be a good fit



Answer These Questions (REQUIRED)

2. What types of videos have you edited most often?

3. What tools are you most comfortable using for video editing and graphic design?

4. Have you used any AI tools to help create or edit videos? If yes, which tools and how did you use them?

5. Please describe your usual process for turning raw video footage into a finished video.

6. Is this your only job, or do you have other work commitments at the 
nt?

7. What type of role or career growth are you aiming for over the next 1–3 years?

8. What’s something creative or unique about you that we won’t find on your resume?



Additional Technical Questions (For Workflow Fit)

1. What computer and internet setup do you currently use for video editing? Please include specs such as RAM, CPU, GPU, and internet speed.

2. In addition to “What types of videos have you edited most often,” what content styles do you prefer or have experience with? (e.g., YouTube talking-head, shorts, educational content, AI avatar content, etc.)

title: Marketing Automation Consultant / Email Marketing Trainer (Project-Based – 1 Month)
description:
Job Title: Marketing Automation Consultant /
 Marketing Trainer (Project-Based – 1 Month)



Job Type: Project-Based / 1-Month Contract

Working Schedule: Monday to Friday | 4 hours per day (Flexible)

Duration: 1 Month



About the Project



We are looking for an experienced
 Marketing Consultant to work with our e-commerce team on a one-month project. This role is ideal for a senior marketing automation specialist who can assess our current
 marketing ecosystem, optimize our automation strategy, implement industry best practices, and coach our internal team to independently manage and scale our retention marketing efforts.



The primary objective of this engagement is to build a strong marketing automation foundation while transferring knowledge and creating sustainable processes for our team.



Project Scope & Responsibilities

1. Marketing Automation Audit

* Review and evaluate our existing Klaviyo account, Shopify integration,
 flows, customer journeys, and segmentation strategy.

* Identify gaps, opportunities, and quick wins to improve customer retention and
 marketing performance.



2. Strategy Development

* Develop a comprehensive lifecycle marketing strategy for our e-commerce brands.

* Recommend best practices for customer journeys, segmentation, automation, and retention campaigns.

* Provide actionable recommendations to improve customer lifetime value, repeat purchases, and engagement.



3. Automation Implementation

* Optimize or build high-performing
 and SMS automation flows.

* Improve existing campaigns and automation logic using customer behavior and data.

* Ensure proper integration between Klaviyo and Shopify.



4. Training & Knowledge Transfer

* Train and mentor our internal marketing team on Klaviyo, lifecycle marketing, segmentation, reporting, and automation best practices.

* Conduct live training sessions and answer team questions throughout the engagement.

* Guide the team through real examples and practical implementation.



5. Documentation & SOP Development

* Create clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and best-practice guides.

* Develop reusable workflows and templates that the team can follow after project completion.



Performance Review

* Review campaign and automation performance using Klaviyo, Shopify, and GA4.

* Provide recommendations for continuous optimization and future growth.

* Deliver a final report summarizing completed work, recommendations, and next steps.



Expected Deliverables:

By the end of the one-month engagement, the consultant should provide:

* A complete audit of the current marketing automation ecosystem

* Optimized lifecycle
 and SMS flows

* Improved segmentation strategy

* Updated automation and campaign recommendations

* Training sessions completed with the internal team

* Documented SOPs and process guides

* Final project report with recommendations and roadmap for future improvements



Qualifications:

* 3+ years of experience in
 Marketing, CRM, or Marketing Automation

* Extensive hands-on experience with Klaviyo and Shopify

* Strong knowledge of customer lifecycle marketing and retention strategies

* Experience analyzing marketing performance using GA4 and e-commerce analytics

* Proven experience consulting, coaching, mentoring, or training marketing teams

* Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills

* Strong project management and organizational abilities



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with multiple e-commerce or DTC brands

* Knowledge of A/B testing and experimentation frameworks

* Experience with additional CRM and marketing automation platforms

* Familiarity with Klaviyo retention marketing, including SMS, Push Notifications, WhatsApp, and paid remarketing



Success Criteria

The project will be considered successful if the consultant:

* Successfully audits and improves the existing marketing automation setup.

* Trains the internal team to confidently manage Klaviyo and lifecycle marketing independently.

ABOUT US



Higgihaus runs a portfolio of aparthotels across Bristol and Cardiff in the UK. We have spent seven years building an operation that runs on tight systems, good data, and a small team that trusts each other. We are not a giant call centre and we never will be. We are a lean operations team that takes guest experience and operational quality seriously.



You would be joining our remote operations team, working alongside our existing operations VA on the evening shift, with a daily overlap hour for handover and team connection. You will be trained directly by the founder and supported as you find your feet. This is a genuine team, not a set of people who only ever clock on when someone else clocks off.



THE ROLE



This is a front-line guest operations role at its core. Your main job is to deliver brilliant, responsive guest communications and keep the operation running smoothly across your morning shift. Much of our routine guest messaging is already handled by automation, so this is not a high-volume copy-paste job. It is about handling the situations that need a real person: judgement calls, live problems during a guest's stay, escalations, the occasional phone call, and keeping guests happy when things do not go to plan.



You need to be a genuinely good communicator. Warm, clear, calm under pressure. That part is non-negotiable because it is the heart of the job.



Beyond comms, we want a systems brain. Our operation runs on Hostaway, Airtable, PriceLabs and a stack of automations. You do not need to be a developer, but you do need to be the kind of person who asks why a problem keeps happening and fixes the cause, not just the symptom. For the right person there is a clear growth path into revenue management, data and automation work over time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

title: Customer Support Associate (Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote position and may require shifting schedules, weekend coverage, and overtime based on business needs.



Who We Are



At Neuro, we empower better minds with innovative, science-backed formulas. Our products are accessible, portable, shareable, and designed to work fast, wherever life takes you.



We're a premium functional wellness brand helping people optimize focus, clarity, energy, and cognitive performance through clean, effective gum and mints.



Neuro has been featured by The Joe Rogan Experience, Fast Company, The New Yorker, and The Daily Beast, and our founders appeared on Shark Tank Season 11.



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Customer Support Associate who genuinely enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment.



This role goes beyond answering tickets - you'll be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across phone,
, live chat, and social media while exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and representing the Neuro brand with professionalism and empathy.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can think critically, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of customer issues from start to finish. We're looking for someone who communicates naturally not someone who relies on scripted responses. Clear writing, sound judgment, and genuine empathy are far more important to us than memorizing processes.



What You'll Do

- Deliver thoughtful, empathetic, and on-brand support across
, live chat, phone, and social media.

- Resolve customer inquiries related to orders, subscriptions, shipping, billing, products, and promotions.

- Prioritize multiple customer requests while maintaining accuracy and response quality.

- Investigate issues independently and determine the best course of action before escalating.

- Take ownership of customer concerns through resolution while keeping customers informed every step of the way.

- Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently across all support channels.

- Maintain accurate documentation, tagging, and customer records within our CRM.

- Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest process improvements.

- Collaborate with Operations, Fulfillment, Marketing, and Ecommerce teams to resolve customer issues.

- Assist during product launches, promotions, and seasonal volume spikes.

- Adapt to changing priorities, workflows, and support channels based on business needs.

- Use AI-powered tools responsibly to improve efficiency while maintaining personalized customer interactions.



What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or another customer-facing role.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and the ability to communicate naturally and concisely.

- Professional verbal communication skills and confidence speaking with customers by phone.

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Customer-first mindset with empathy, professionalism, and accountability.

- Comfortable switching between phone,
, live chat, and social media support depending on business needs.

- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free remote work environment.

- Willingness to work shifting schedules and overtime when required.



**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience using one or more of the following:

- Shopify

- Gorgias

- Zendesk

- Amazon Seller Central

- TikTok Seller Center

- Skio, Recharge, or other subscription platforms

- ShipHero or similar warehouse/order management systems

- AI tools that support customer service workflows



**What Success Looks Like**

You'll be successful in this role if you:

- Deliver accurate, thoughtful, and timely responses across every customer interaction.

- Know how to balance multiple priorities without compromising quality.

- Take ownership of customer issues instead of simply responding to tickets.

- Communicate with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.

- Make sound decisions independently while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.

- Continuously look for opportunities to improve the customer experience and internal processes.

- Represent the Neuro brand with every interaction.



**Why You'll Love Working at Neuro**

- Fully remote work environment.

- Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing functional wellness brands.

- Collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team.

- Work that directly impacts our customers and business growth.

- A culture that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



**How to Apply**



If you're interested in joining the Neuro team, please
 the following to 

- A PDF copy of your resume.

- A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom, Google Drive, or another shareable link) telling us a little about yourself, your customer support experience, and why you're interested in joining Neuro.

- Your response to the customer scenario below.



Customer Scenario



A customer
s the following:



Subject: Subscription Charge



Hi,



I was charged for my Neuro subscription again, but I was sure I canceled it last month. I'm pretty frustrated because I wasn't expecting this charge. Can you please refund me and let me know what happened?



Thanks.



Please draft the
 you would send to this customer.



**** We're looking for your natural communication style, problem-solving approach, and ability to deliver a thoughtful customer experience. Please complete this exercise using your own words.



 Subject Line



Rockstar CS – [Your Full Name]



***Please Note***

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.
